patch.summary: Is Gong worth it? Conversation intelligence and revenue AI platform for capturing customer interactions, coaching, deal insight, and CRM-connected revenue workflows — priced per user with a platform fee via custom proposal (no public dollar list). sections.heading: Verdict shape for Gong
sections.body:
Evaluator thesis: Yes for teams where Revenue teams whose primary job is conversation intelligence and deal coaching matter more than polish elsewhere. Counter-signal: No when Compare Outreach/Salesloft when engagement sequencing is primary; ZoomInfo/Apollo when contact data is primary; Fireflies-class tools for lighter meeting notes..

Capability hinge for this product: prospecting; data enrichment; email outreach; crm sync.

Integrations in research: Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach, Salesloft.

Paid tiers that usually matter in evaluation: Gong Platform.

sections.heading: Who Gong is worth it for — and who should avoid it
sections.body:
Worth it for: Choose Gong when conversation intelligence and revenue coaching are the job — mention it on SI pages as adjacent landscape, not as a contact-database peer..

Avoid if: Compare Outreach/Salesloft when engagement sequencing is primary; ZoomInfo/Apollo when contact data is primary; Fireflies-class tools for lighter meeting notes..

If avoid signals dominate, start the alternative path with Outreach on the same job-to-be-done.

sections.heading: Gong price/value and next evaluation step
sections.body:
No free/trial flag in SG data — scope a paid proof with exit criteria before annual seats.

Tradeoff to accept consciously: Data depth / intent specialization vs outreach execution built-in.

Next step: run prospecting end-to-end, then decide.
